name: google/gemini-3.5-flash
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash is the Flash model of Google's Gemini 3.5 family, introduced at Google I/O in May 2026. Google positions it as delivering frontier-level intelligence at Flash speed, built for sub-agent deployment, multi-step workflows and long-horizon tasks at scale, and particularly effective in rapid agentic loops with complex coding iterations. It takes text, image, video, audio and PDF input with text output; Google's model list now labels it a legacy Flash model behind 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 Flash.
